description: sse-copy-npc-vmad-shown with a name of Update.esm (RedguardRace [RACE:00013748], Nazeem's race) read after Nazeem [NPC_:00013BBF] is shown and before the copy, so the release has Update.esm's tables loaded when the copy adds Nazeem's names to them and keeps its strings. The copy of a shown record keeps the order the view sorted its arrays in, so its bytes are not those of sse-copy-npc-vmad. These are the saves the port must give for sse-copy-npc-vmad-shown, where the release loses the tables (UPSTREAM-BUG, issue #75).
